ns2:section.sectionText: ENGINEERING RESEARCH IN ACTION: Research can be interesting and exciting and have a tremendous impact on society. The different types of research on campus (e.g., NCSA, Engineering, Computer Science) wil be showcased. Students will have an opportunity to participate in a class team research study that highlights the interactive, creative, and humanitarian side of the engineering field. APPROVED AS OTHER SOCIAL SCIENCE / HUMANITY COURSE IN ENGINEERING.
